Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the intro earlier this week. We did a quick review of your partner intake form — Ananta can support a Basel pilot for EU customers and we have an APAC practice in Singapore that can run private deployments. Before we lock scope we'd like to confirm: 1) whether Redwood expects retainer-based monthly M&O (managed & operations) or a fixed SOW for rollout, and 2) what controls are non-negotiable for data residency (KMS in-region, audit log retention, ability to block egress to third-party analytics).

I've attached a short capabilities deck and sample retainer terms. Proposed call: Mon 4 Oct 08:00 SGT / Sun 3 Oct 17:00 PDT — does that work?

Best,

Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — local SI support + data residency constraints

Thanks Meera — call works for me (Mon 4 Oct 08:00 SGT). High level from our side: we anticipate two engagement phases — 1) pilot (4–8 weeks) to validate private deployment templates and drift handling, and 2) ongoing retainer for ops and customer support for local deployments. For pilots we prefer fixed SOW; for production we expect monthly retainer (tiered by concurrent customers).

Critical residency asks: KMS keys in-customer-region (we can support BYOK), audit log streaming to customer-managed storage, and opt-out of any telemetry to external analytics. We'll share a proposed data-residency matrix. Please bring your APAC infra lead to the kickoff.

Agenda for Mon: quick intros, confirm scope for a Basel EU pilot, map KMS/keys flow, and agree on SOW vs retainer milestones.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW-data-residency-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kai Müller <kai@torus-sys.com>

Cc: Meera Nair <meera@ananta.consult>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 16:34:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick note ahead of Monday — Torus integration constraints

Hi all,

Torus Systems will be the tooling partner for local telemetry ingestion (EU region). Two quick technical constraints to call out ahead of the call: 1) our collector requires outbound HTTPS to our EU gateway but supports IP allowlisting per-customer, 2) we can deploy a local ingress proxy in-customer VPC if required by compliance, but that pushes the timeline +2 weeks.

If we need strict zero-egress to third parties we can propose an on-prem proxy model. We'll prepare a short diagram for Monday showing where KMS handoffs and log shipping occur.

—Kai
Director, Enterprise Integrations, Torus Systems
Attachment: torus-ingress-proxy-diagram.png (png)

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 07:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: EU/APAC local SI retainer and data residency workflow

Great — thanks Kai and Meera for the heads up. Quick meeting notes from today's sync:

- Pilot model: fixed SOW for a single Basel customer (EU) to validate private deployment template (4–6 weeks). Deliverables: deployment playbook, KMS BYOK runbook, audit log pipeline.
- Retainer model: monthly managed support (SLA-backed), tiers: Bronze (business hours), Silver (24x5), Gold (24x7). Pricing to be attached to SOW.
- Data residency must include: customer-managed KMS in-region OR HSM BYOK; audit logs streamed to customer-controlled storage (S3/GCS/Azure) with retention policy agreed per account; option for Torus on-prem ingress proxy for zero-egress.
- Owners: Ananta lead = Meera (delivery + local ops), Torus lead = Kai (ingest), Redwood tech owner = Soojin (runtime templates), Redwood commercial = Marissa (SOW/pricing), Redwood legal = Sergio (contract redlines).
- Next steps: Ananta to send a draft SOW and proposed retainer terms by EOD Wed 6 Oct; Torus to publish ingress proxy diagram and a minimal config sample; Redwood to produce a data-residency matrix and a proposed SLAs table.

Action items assigned in thread. I'll consolidate into a single SOW draft for review once Ananta's draft arrives.

-Rishi

Thanks Rishi — sending the initial SOW draft and retainer term sheet attached (see RDW-SOW-Ananta-Initial-Draft.pdf and retainer-terms-v1.docx). A couple of clarifications: 1) for the Basel pilot we scoped 6 weeks because we expect an additional week for Torus proxy deployment if the customer elects zero-egress; 2) our retainer model assumes a monthly minimum commitment (2 engineers, up to 40 hours/month) and a separate on-call uplift.

Request: can Redwood confirm whether the customer wants logs delivered to their sovereign storage or to a Redwood-managed bucket in-region (we recommended sovereign storage for Basel).

Best,
Meera
